product.name: DSG ONE
product.role: Deterministic AI governance, verified action compilation, and managed autonomous-agent control plane

discovery.description: Returns the unified DSG MCP server metadata and tool catalogue.

agent_interface.authentication: Tool execution is authenticated and governed by the Control Plane. Public discovery does not imply execution permission.

implemented: Verified Solution to Action IR compiler
final receipt hash construction when upstream proof-chain hashes are supplied
not_yet_complete: Managed IR Runner that directly consumes the compiled DAG and invokes all executor tools
server-side revalidation of upstream Cinema/Z3 proof authenticity inside the compiler
automatic execution counterexample to re-solve loop
verified_action_runtime.execution_rule: Compilation PASS is never execution permission. Managed execution must resolve live preconditions, permission, risk, and exact-plan approval before calling a registered executor.
verified_action_runtime.completion_rule: Executor success is never COMPLETED. Independent postcondition evidence plus the complete proof chain are required.

storefront.role: Canonical human-facing storefront and lead entry point

customer_agent_flow.instruction: Read this manifest, then GET the canonical MCP URL to discover the currently available unified DSG tools.
Choose only a capability returned by /api/mcp. Do not infer unsupported capabilities.
Provide a valid DSG session or supported MCP credential before any governed tool call.
Obtain a verified solution with its upstream proof hash. A solver result alone does not authorize external side effects.
Call dsg.action.compile. Do not translate the verified solution into free-form commands. If the result is BLOCK or UNSUPPORTED, stop.
Execute only the registered executor tools and exact arguments represented by the compiled Action IR after live preconditions and approval are satisfied.
Use independent observations and dsg.action.verifyAcceptance. Never treat executor success as acceptance.
Return the exact DSG verdict and receipt/evidence identifiers. Never convert BLOCK, REVIEW, UNSUPPORTED, or unverified output into PASS or COMPLETED.

checkout.note: Use Control Plane pricing and checkout. Do not use separately-created storefront prices as the product source of truth.
